free_tier.stated: Free tier: 2GB of storage (FAQ: 'Free: 2GB'), 480p streaming, no daily or monthly transfer limits. Paid plans start at Lite, $3.95/mo for 10GB.

retention.stated: Files remain in storage until deleted; free and paid accounts keep files indefinitely.
retention.notes: The FAQ states retention: 'Both free and paid accounts keep files indefinitely.'

egress.terms: No daily or monthly limits for free users (the vendor says this can change at any time); paid plans have no monthly limits either. The storage limit is the binding constraint.

tooling: Browser + browser extension + a 'Seedr Connector' desktop agent. FTP/FTPS/SFTP access is a paid feature (listed on Basic and above: 'FTP, FTPS & SFTP access'), and WebDAV appears only at Pro ('FTP, SFTP & WebDAV storages'). So on the free tier there is no programmatic transport at all.
chaining: Free quota is 2GB ('Free: 2GB') and the useful transports (FTP/SFTP/WebDAV) are paid-plan features; referral bonus is 500MB per signup, up to 2GB total. Per-account 2GB makes multiplying accounts a low-yield route.
limits_note: per-object-cap: the FAQ says 'The maximum file size equals your available storage space.' Request-rate: 'no daily or monthly limits for free users'. Retention: 'Both free and paid accounts keep files indefinitely.' Free storage is 2GB ('Free: 2GB'); FTP/SFTP/WebDAV are paid-plan features.

identity_cost.detail: Free tier is 2GB ('Free: 2GB'). Paid tiers start at Lite $3.95/mo for 10 GB; the FAQ lists 'Credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)' as payment methods for paid plans. What a free sign-up asks for: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Quota is intentionally hidden, which is itself the finding — you cannot size a workload against an unpublished number.
confidence_note: The FAQ page was read on 2026-11-04 and states the free quota ('Free: 2GB') and retention ('Both free and paid accounts keep files indefinitely.'); the free sign-up requirements stay unverified: behind a sign-up.
